title: SVBench: Evaluation of Video Generation Models on Social Reasoning
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on social reasoning in video generation models from a psychological perspective, not a religious one.

measurement_description: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on evaluating video generation models' ability to represent social reasoning, based on paradigms from developmental and social psychology, such as mental-state inference, goal-directed action, and social norms.
